title: Lānaʻi Fifth Street affordable housing project
summary: A council member said on April 22 that the Lānaʻi project with the Department of Hawaiian Home Lands (DHHL) would clear the island's housing list. On January 7 the council approved Resolution 26-4, a ground lease for a long-term affordable housing project on Lānaʻi, and filed the older lease resolution it replaced. The developer said a state funding application process starts in February, and land control is a key part of it.
